تعالجت (form VI)
# تَعَالَجْتُ (taʕālajtu) /ta.ʕaː.lad͡ʒ.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَعَالَجَ (taʕālaja)
# تَعَالَجْتَ (taʕālajta) /ta.ʕaː.lad͡ʒ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَعَالَجَ (taʕālaja)
# تَعَالَجْتِ (taʕālajti) /ta.ʕaː.lad͡ʒ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَعَالَجَ (taʕālaja)
# تَعَالَجَتْ (taʕālajat) /ta.ʕaː.la.d͡ʒat/: third-pe
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
